excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]的轨道俘获了一个小型未知物体，其正以难以置信的高速移动。
excerpt.en: Caught in an orbit around [From.GetName] is a small, unknown object moving at such a high speed it beggars belief.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]的轨道俘获了一个小型未知物体，其正以难以置信的高速移动。
texts.en: Caught in an orbit around [From.GetName] is a small, unknown object moving at such a high speed it beggars belief.

sections.zh: [From.GetName]的轨道俘获了一个小型未知物体，其正以难以置信的高速移动。
sections.en: Caught in an orbit around [From.GetName] is a small, unknown object moving at such a high speed it beggars belief.

texts.zh:
对[From.GetName]高空轨道的高速物体进行扫描的尝试失败了。物体很快便从视野中消失，而科研船的各项仪器根本无法跟上它的速度。

虽然[From.GetName]的引力强度很大，但该物体的移动速度依旧令人难以置信。要么是这个物体本身带有什么非凡属性，要么就是引力的奇迹造成了这一奇景。

物体的速度似乎正在逐渐增加，科研官员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为就算没有外界干预，该物体也很可能即将被抛出轨道。
texts.en:
Attempts to scan the object in high-speed orbit of [From.GetName] have been unsuccessful. The object quickly falls below [From.GetName]'s horizon and the [Root.GetName]'s instruments are simply unable to keep up.

While [From.GetName]'s gravitational pull is strong, that alone does little to explain the object's extreme momentum. Either the object itself possesses some extraordinary properties, or there is some gravitational phenomenon at work here.

The object's velocity appears to be increasing over time, and Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] suspects that it may soon be thrown out of orbit, even without outside interference.

tooltips.zh: 派出无人机进行拖拽，以求降低其动量。
tooltips.en: Dispatch a drone and attempt to latch onto the object to reduce its momentum.

tooltips.zh: 投掷废物与其相撞，以求打乱其轨道运行。
tooltips.en: Eject debris to collide with the object, hopefully stopping it in its orbital tracks.

tooltips.zh: 离开危险区域，让这物体自生自灭。
tooltips.en: Move out of harm's way and leave the object to its fate.

texts.zh:
投掷的废物成功与未知物体相撞，降低了其飞行速度，并令其掉出了轨道。[Root.GetName]不久后成功将其回收。

该物体类似盒子，由外星材质构成，外部具有如血管般的突脊，一路延伸至顶部的一个球状机构。至于其内含何物目前尚不得而知。
texts.en:
The ejected debris successfully collided with the unknown object, reducing its velocity before knocking it out of orbit. The [Root.GetName] was able to retrieve it soon thereafter.

The object looks to be some sort of box, constructed of alien material. Vein-like ridges meander along its sides, congregating at the top in some type of sphere-shaped mechanism. We can only guess at its contents.

texts.zh:
无人机已成功停止了未知物体的轨道飞行。

无人机放出拉索拖拽物体，逐渐降低其速度，最终成功将其引导至[Root.GetName]并进行了回收。

该物体类似盒子，由外星材质构成，外部具有如血管般的突脊，一路延伸至顶部的一个球状机构。至于其内含何物目前尚不得而知。
texts.en:
The drone successfully intercepted the unknown object's orbit.

By latching onto the object and then thrusting in reverse little by little, the drone was eventually able to direct it to the [Root.GetName] for retrieval.

The object looks to be some sort of box, constructed of alien material. Vein-like ridges meander along its sides, congregating at the top in some type of sphere-shaped mechanism. We can only guess at its contents.

tooltips.zh: 将这外星盒子射入深空。
tooltips.en: Shoot the alien box into deep space.

texts.zh: 开始着手撬开在[speed_demon_orbit_body.GetName]轨道发现的外星盒子。
texts.en: Begin the efforts to open the alien box found in orbit of [speed_demon_orbit_body.GetName].

texts.zh:
历经长久努力，我们的科学家终于穿透了外星盒子的外部材料。

盒子内装着的三个小型容器，的确分别盛有不同的液体——一种红色，一种蓝色，还有一种绿色。这些液体比外面的容器更为常见，我方科学家已确定其为基因改造媒介。

出于未知原因，溶液移出外星容器后开始急剧腐坏，但我们尚有足够时间开始人工合成其中的一种，并将其应用于我们的物种。目前已确定其效果一定有益，但具体如何有益尚不明确。
texts.en:
At long last, our scientists have penetrated the outer material of the alien box.

The three small vials inside are indeed filled with different liquids - one red, one blue, and one green. The liquids are less alien than their container and our scientists have identified them as primed gene-modification mediums.

For reasons beyond our understanding, the solutions are quickly deteriorating outside their alien container, but there should be enough time to synthesize and apply one of them to our species. It has been confirmed that its effects would be positive, but exactly how remains to be seen.

texts.zh:
历经长久努力，我们的科学家终于穿透了外星盒子的外部材料。

盒子内装着三个小型容器，分别盛有不同的液体——一种红色，一种蓝色，还有一种绿色。这些液体比外面的容器更为常见，我方科学家已确定其为基因改造媒介。

出于未知原因，溶液移出外星容器后开始急剧腐坏，但我们尚有足够时间开始人工合成其中的一种，并将其应用于我们的物种。目前已确定其效果一定有益，但具体如何有益尚不明确。
texts.en:
At long last, our scientists have penetrated the outer material of the alien box.

The box holds three small liquid-filled vials - one red, one blue, and one green. The liquids are less alien than their container and our scientists have identified them as primed gene-modification mediums.

For reasons beyond our understanding, the solutions are quickly deteriorating outside their alien container, but there should be enough time to synthesize and apply one of them to our species. It has been confirmed that its effects would be positive, but exactly how remains to be seen.

tooltips.zh: 使用红色溶液对[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]各物种进行改造。
tooltips.en: Modify the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] species with the red solution.

tooltips.zh: 使用绿色溶液对[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]各物种进行改造。
tooltips.en: Modify the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] species with the green solution.

tooltips.zh: 使用蓝色溶液对[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]各物种进行改造。
tooltips.en: Modify the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] species with the blue solution.

label.zh: 别在这犹犹豫豫的，全部干了！
label.en: No time for half measures, use them all!

tooltips.zh:
两个选项之一将会发生：
50%几率获得所有溶液的增益。
50%几率无事发生。
tooltips.en:
One of 2 options will happen:
50% chance of gaining the benefits from all solutions.
50% chance of nothing happening.

tooltips.zh: 把容器卖给出价最高的人。
tooltips.en: Sell the vials to the highest bidder.

texts.zh:
我们早已精通合成以及发展独特染色体的能力，结果完全不出意料。我们成功地将红色、绿色和蓝色的溶液一起施加给了[root.GetSpeciesName]物种。

我们的物种现在更加融洽、适应且长寿了。
texts.en:
As masters of synthesizing and deploying unique genomes the outcome was never in doubt. We have managed to apply the red, green, and blue solutions to the [root.GetSpeciesName] species.

Our species is now more social, adaptable, and longer-lived.

texts.zh:
红色基因改造溶液已成功注入[Root.GetSpeciesName]人民。

根据对早期实验对象的初步观察，这种溶液似乎会让我们变得更加合群。
texts.en:
The red gene-modification solution has been successfully administered to the [Root.GetSpeciesName] people.

Based on preliminary observations of early subjects, the solution appears to make us more social.

texts.zh:
绿色溶液已成功用于对[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]民众的改造。

基于对第一批实验对象的观察，这种溶液似乎可以增强我们对环境的适应能力。
texts.en:
The green gene-modification solution has been successfully administered to the [Root.GetSpeciesName] people.

Based on preliminary observations of early subjects, the solution appears to improve our ability to adapt to our environment.

texts.zh:
蓝色溶液已成功用于对[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]民众的改造。

基于对第一批实验对象的观察，这种溶液似乎可以延长我们的寿命。
texts.en:
The blue gene-modification solution has been successfully administered to the [Root.GetSpeciesName] people.

Based on preliminary observations of early subjects, the solution appears to increase our potential lifespan.

texts.zh: 尽管初期结果乐观，基因改造最终不幸失败，因为这种溶液与更加普遍的[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]基因组不相容。
texts.en: The attempted gene modification was unfortunately a failure despite promising initial results, as the solutions proved incompatible with the wider [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] genome.

texts.zh: 研究在[speed_demon_orbit_body.GetName]轨道发现的外星盒子，以查明其内容物。
texts.en: Research the alien box found in orbit of [speed_demon_orbit_body.GetName] to ascertain its contents.

texts.zh:
我们的[Root.GetScientistPlural]终于在不破坏盒子的情况下调查出了盒内的情况。通过使用先进的声呐系统，他们成功确认了盒子的内容物。

里面的物品十分令人困惑，也可以说是出人意料。里面装着三个小型容器，每个里面都装着一种未知的液体。

盒子是可以安全打开的，但想要找出打开的办法还需要更多的研究。
texts.en:
Finally, our [Root.GetScientistPlural] have managed a peek into the alien box without compromising the container itself. By utilizing an advanced type of sonar, they have been able to identify its contents.

The contents are puzzling or, at least, unexpected. The box holds three small vials, each filled with an unknown liquid.

The box is safe to open, but it will require further research to understand how.

tooltips.zh: 对盒子的研究加速了我们对£physics£ 物理学知识的了解。
tooltips.en:
Research of the box has accelerated
our £physics£ Physics knowledge.

tooltips.zh: 把盒子卖给最高出价者。
tooltips.en: Sell the box to the highest bidder.

tooltips.zh: 对盒子的研究加速了我们对£physics£ 物理学知识的了解。
tooltips.en:
Research of the box has accelerated
our £physics£ Physics knowledge.

tooltips.zh: 通过中子活化分析，我们可以更好地了解制作盒子的材料和内容。
tooltips.en: Through neutron activation analysis, we can better understand what materials were used to make the box and the contents.

summary.text:
# 轨道高速妖 / Orbital Speed Demon

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：无DLC检查（定义位于《遥远繁星》文件中，但类别与事件都不检查 has_distar）/ no DLC check (defined in the Distant Stars files, but neither category nor events test has_distar) · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/95_anomaly_categories_distant_stars.txt:1664-1688; events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:8492 (distar.3050); events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:8532 (distar.3051); common/special_projects/00_projects_distant_stars.txt:847/867 (speed_demon_open_box_project, speed_demon_learn_more_project); events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:8585 (distar.3055); events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:8700 (distar.3056); events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:8769 (distar.3057)

## 如何开始 How it starts

无战略资源的小行星可能生成（4级，权重2）；合成或荒野帝国为0。

Can spawn on asteroids without strategic resources (level 4, weight 2); 0 for synthetic or Wilderness empires.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

distar.3050：一个速度越来越快的小物体绕小行星飞行。减速或拦截 → 5天后 distar.3051：回收到一个外星盒子（两种正文对应两种方法）；离开则结束。
distar.3051：打开 → speed_demon_open_box_project（2000）→ distar.3055：盒中三支基因改造液（红/绿/蓝），选一支 → 5天后 distar.3057“基因改造完成”（红：更社交；绿：更强适应力；蓝：更长寿命，按已有特质升级），或卖掉；演化猎手可全部使用（50%全部生效/50%失败）。研究 → speed_demon_learn_more_project（1000）→ distar.3056：可再打开（回到开盒项目）、卖掉或（格式塔）辐照分析。丢掉 → 结束。

distar.3050: a small object circles the asteroid ever faster. Slow it down or halt it → distar.3051 five days later: an alien box is retrieved (one text per method); get away and it ends.
distar.3051: open it → speed_demon_open_box_project (2000) → distar.3055: three gene-modification vials (red/green/blue); use one → distar.3057 "Genetic Modification Complete" five days later (red: more social; green: more adaptable; blue: longer-lived, upgrading existing traits), or sell them; Evolutionary Predators can use all (50% all work / 50% nothing). Study it → speed_demon_learn_more_project (1000) → distar.3056: open it after all (back to the opening project), sell it, or (gestalts) irradiate it. Get rid of it → end.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

三种溶液互斥；distar.3057 的十一个同名选项只是按改造结果显示的确认。

The three solutions are exclusive; distar.3057's eleven same-name options are just confirmations matching the modification result.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

distar.3056 的出售仅限非格式塔，辐照仅限格式塔。

distar.3056: sell for non-gestalts, irradiate for gestalts.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对异常、distar.3050–3057 与两个项目。树结构正确。

Checked the anomaly, distar.3050–3057 and both projects. Tree correct.
